# CRF Online Academy

> Craddle Reading Foundation (CRF) Online Academy — Nigeria's online Nursery and Primary school. Kindergarten and Primary 1–6 courses with video lessons, PDF workbooks, quizzes, assignments and certificates. ₦3,000 per course, paid securely with Paystack.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the academy, featured courses, and how learning works.
- [All courses](/courses): Full catalog of Kindergarten and Primary 1–6 courses across English, Mathematics, Basic Science, Reading Skills, Phonics and Common Entrance exam prep.
- [Summer courses](/summer): Holiday and enrichment courses — Summer English, Mathematics, Reading, Revision and general enrichment.
- [About](/about): Our story, mission, and what we believe about Nigerian basic education.
- [Admissions](/admissions): Apply online for the current academic session.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp and email — the team responds within 24 hours.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Student, parent, teacher and admin sign-in.
